_comment: Pre-registered before the first validation run. Rules and numbers fixed in advance; any later change must be listed with a reason in docs/VALIDATION.md.

identity.rule: residual <= c * nOps * machineEpsilon * rho * scale; rho = max over cells of h/theta (diameter over inscribed-ball diameter); scale = max(1, max|field| over the mesh)
identity.quadratureNote: Identities are tested on polynomial fields whose degree is integrated exactly by the quadrature order in use; quadrature-limited residuals are reported separately and must decrease with order.

convergence.rule: lower 95% confidence bound of fitted log-log slope >= theoreticalOrder - delta, over >= minRefinements refinements

stableOperator._comment: Added before any Stage S code or test existed. Same identity rule as 'identity'.
stableOperator.identityRule: same as identity.rule, with nOps = 1000 because each DoF is an exact local-solve sum over an extended star
stableOperator.localSolveResidual: relative residual of every local constraint (div eta = rhs, curl eta = rhs, grad eta = rhs) <= c * machineEpsilon * condition estimate, with c = 100; larger residual means the star violates the paper's assumptions and must raise SingularError

stability.fieldNote: bound ||Pi u||_L2(tau) <= C ||u||_L2(ES(tau)) estimated over a fixed set of test fields

singularField.requirement: finite output; change between mesh sizes n=2 and n=4 bounded by 10 times the smooth-field change
